title: Double Glass Shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount with Gallery Rail, Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade storage with a wall-mounted double glass shelf designed to save space while keeping everyday items organized. This 16 x 5-inch tempered glass shelf uses 3/8-inch thick glass for strength and safety, with a gallery rail to help keep items in place. Crafted from solid brass materials, it brings a refined look that suits transitional bath accessories and coordinated spaces in the waverly place collection.

Highlights:
- Double shelf design is an ideal use of space
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for safety and strength
- Gallery rail helps keep toiletries and décor items in place
- Solid brass hardware for a lasting, premium feel
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean wall-mounted look

Specs:
- Category: Glass Shelves
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 8-Inch H; 5-Inch projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: Brass (hardware)
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Includes: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available for matching waverly place and other transitional bathroom hardware
